items.title: Do I need to be home during the service?
items.content: No. As long as we have access, we'll handle everything and update you if needed, keeping you informed throughout the process.

items.title: How do I know which service I need?
items.content: We offer a free initial consultation to assess your garden's condition and discuss your goals, helping you choose the perfect maintenance plan.

items.title: How much will it cost?
items.content: Pricing depends on the size of your garden and the specific services required. Contact us for a detailed and transparent custom quote.

items.title: Do you offer one-time services?
items.content: Yes, we provide one-time cleanups, seasonal pruning, and storm restoration alongside our regular ongoing maintenance packages.

items.title: What if my garden is overgrown?
items.content: No problem at all! We love transformations. Our team will perform an initial restoration service to bring it back to a beautiful, manageable state.

items.title: How soon can you start?
items.content: We can usually schedule an initial visit or consultation within 3-5 business days depending on our current seasonal workload.

items.title: What is included in garden maintenance services?
items.content: Our regular maintenance covers lawn mowing, weeding, hedge trimming, soil cultivation, deadheading flowers, and seasonal cleanups.

items.title: How often should garden maintenance be scheduled?
items.content: For the best results, we recommend weekly or bi-weekly visits during the peak growing season, and monthly checks during winter.

items.title: Do you offer monthly garden maintenance plans?
items.content: Yes, we have subscription-based monthly and seasonal plans tailored to your garden’s specific ecosystem and needs.

items.title: Can I customize my maintenance plan?
items.content: Absolutely. You can choose specific areas you want us to focus on or add services like organic fertilizing and pest control whenever needed.

items.title: What happens if I skip regular maintenance?
items.content: Skipping maintenance can allow weeds and pests to multiply quickly, which often increases the cost and effort required for the next cleanup.

items.title: How is pricing determined?
items.content: Pricing is based on garden size, the complexity of the plants, access to the site, and the frequency of visits you choose.

items.title: Do you offer fixed packages or custom quotes?
items.content: We offer both! We have standard foundational packages for basic care, as well as fully bespoke quotes for complex landscape management.

items.title: What payment methods do you accept?
items.content: We accept all major credit cards, secure bank transfers, and automated monthly billing for our subscription plan clients.

items.title: How do I schedule a service?
items.content: You can schedule a service by contacting us through our website, phone, or email. We'll help you find a convenient date and time.

items.title: Can I reschedule or cancel a booking?
items.content: Yes. Simply let us know at least 24 hours in advance, and we'll gladly reschedule or cancel your appointment.

items.title: Do you offer one-time services?
items.content: Yes, we offer one-time gardening services, seasonal cleanups, and special maintenance visits in addition to recurring plans.

items.title: Do gardens need different care in different seasons?
items.content: Yes. Every season requires different maintenance, from spring planting and summer watering to autumn cleanup and winter protection.

items.title: Will you advise what my garden needs each season?
items.content: Absolutely. Our team provides seasonal recommendations to keep your garden healthy and thriving throughout the year.

items.title: How do I know if my plants are healthy?
items.content: Healthy plants have strong growth, vibrant leaves, and minimal signs of disease or pest damage. We can inspect your garden and provide expert guidance.

items.title: Do you handle pests and weeds?
items.content: Yes. We provide effective weed management and environmentally responsible pest control solutions to protect your garden.

items.title: Can you help revive a neglected garden?
items.content: Yes. We specialize in restoring neglected gardens through pruning, cleanup, soil improvement, and ongoing maintenance.

items.title: Are your gardeners experienced?
items.content: Yes. Our gardeners are trained professionals with extensive experience in garden maintenance, landscaping, and plant care.

items.title: Will my property be safe during service?
items.content: Absolutely. Our team treats every property with care, follows strict safety procedures, and always leaves your garden clean and secure after each visit.
